WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY mktnote
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS benchmark_avg
  FROM matched
), kept AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, b.benchmark_avg
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE b.benchmark_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate), AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_avg)
FROM kept
